slug: 2026-02-23 Central Bank Of Tunisia Reports 81% Surge In Mobile Payments As Tunisia Accelerates Its Digital Transformation In 2025

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Tunisia bulletin, as reported, counts 435 licensed payment service providers in 2025, up from 368 in 2024.

The Central Bank of Tunisia reports 8.4 million mobile payment transactions worth TND 1,769 million and 815,000 active digital wallets in 2025, with person-to-person transfers 50.7% of mobile operations.
